explication: Transformers.js runs pretrained models in browser and server-side JavaScript through task-oriented pipelines. The principal workflow selects a task and model, discovers required files, loads preprocessing components and model sessions, runs inference, then postprocesses results. Its model-family implementations and shared tensor operations form the execution layer; ONNX Runtime supplies the backend. The repository also includes a structured-output package for constrained generation. Edges reflect the README and shown source references; unsampled implementation links are omitted or marked unverified.
